title: 8 things to do alone that build *confidence*

label: NUMBER 1
head: Eat at a restaurant alone
sub: Table for one, phone in your pocket. Just eat and watch the room.

label: NUMBER 2
head: Go to the movies alone
sub: Watch the film you want. Nobody to check with first.

label: NUMBER 3
head: Take a solo trip
sub: Even one night in a city 2 hours away. You figure out everything yourself.

label: NUMBER 4
head: Sit at the bar and talk to the bartender
sub: No wingman. Order, ask how their night is going, see where it goes.

head: Saturday night
l: Out alone, fine in his own company
r: Home waiting for a text back

text: Once you're fine *by yourself,* you stop needing anyone's approval.
